Services FAQ

01

Repair vs spare swap—which comes first?

Safety first. If the casing is damaged or you are in traffic, we stabilize the vehicle and install your spare when possible, then repair or replace as appropriate.

02

Can one visit cover truck and trailer tires?

Often yes—tell dispatch how many axles are affected so we bring enough air and torque equipment.

03

How do I book?

Pick the closest service below, then call 1-888-XXX-XXXX with your location and photos of the tire.
